## Done — board-banner-lint (F2), in the working tree

Both M4 features that were claimed-but-never-written now exist, **TDD (failing test first)**, across only the two permitted scripts (445 insertions, 0 deletions — no existing line removed, so no existing test/logic weakened).

**A — staleness banner**
- `stalenessText(generatedAtMs, nowMs, thresholdMs = 30·60·1000)` → PT `dados gerados há <age> — podem estar defasados` when `gap > threshold`, else `null` (humanize min/h/dias; no clock inside the pure helper).
- A `<div id="staleness-banner" … role="status" hidden>` at the top of `<body>`, revealed **client-side at view time** by `boardStalenessCheck()` (exposed on `window` for the Playwright probe).

**B — contradiction ⚠ lint**
- `missionContradictions(mission)` → PT reasons for Done+no-verdict, `gate:approve-plan`+handoffs>0, `gate:ratify`+FAIL.
- A `⚠ chip-contradicao` per contradictory card; reasons joined `; ` in `title`+`aria-label`, `esc()`'d. Counted by the full `class="chip chip-contradicao"` attribute (never the stylesheet — the M3 false-red trap).

**Two decisions worth your eye** (both documented in `HANDOFF.md`):
1. **`data-generated-at` is rendered empty, not a baked ISO.** A baked ISO is a *new* timestamp occurrence that `stripTimestampLines` doesn't strip → it would churn the autopublish content hash and break the existing `board-autopublish.test.mjs:555` ("identical state hashes identically"). Autopublish is out of my file scope, so the client mirrors the footer `<time datetime>` instead. Behavior is identical; the validator's "inject old `data-generated-at` + re-run" probe still works. Baking the ISO instead is a one-liner in `stripTimestampLines` if you prefer.
2. **`gateReason` matches the real model labels** (`gate:approve-plan`/`gate:ratify`), not the contract's `approve-plan`/`ratify` shorthand — otherwise the lint would never fire on real data, which is the exact failure this mission fixes.

## ⚠ What I could NOT do in this seat
This is a read-only-except-edits caged seat. The permission layer gated **every** `node`/`pnpm` invocation (`pnpm test`, `node --test`, `node --check`, the `/tmp/f2.html` smoke) **and** mutating git (`git add`, `git commit`). Only read-only git ran. So:
- I could **not witness red→green** or run the smoke. Correctness rests on a line-by-line hand-review (every assertion traced to the implementation, including confirming no existing test counts chips, asserts body-order, or is disturbed by Done+null-verdict fixtures now rendering a chip).
- I could **not commit**. The change is in the working tree of `agent/board-banner-lint`; a coordinator should commit (code first, then the dossier).

**Expected on `pnpm test`:** ~20 new tests green, all pre-existing green. The held-out validator runs `pnpm test` + Playwright (inject old `data-generated-at` + `window.boardStalenessCheck()` → banner visible with "defasad"; seed Done+no-verdict → ⚠ chip).

Working tree: `scripts/board-report.mjs` + `scripts/board-report.test.mjs` modified; `missions/factory/board-banner-lint/{brief,contract,HANDOFF}.md` untracked. (`node_modules/`, `.claude/` are untracked and should not be committed.)
